sources.title: Sources
sources.subtitle: Where documents come from besides manual upload, and how fresh they are.
sources.name: Source name
sources.tokenTitle: Feeder token: copy it now, it will not be shown again.
sources.tokenNote: On the PM's computer: OCTOBRIEF_FEEDER_TOKEN=… node apps/feeder/src/cli.ts … (see demo/04-fonti).

hints.m365: Mail, Teams and SharePoint read by the feeder on the PM's computer through Claude and the Microsoft 365 connector: no Graph permission.
hints.dwsi: The data warehouse read from the PM's computer with read-only credentials: the connection never goes through the server.
hints.files: A folder of the PM's computer (a synced SharePoint library too) or a file of items.
hints.jira: Read by the server every 15 minutes with a read-only token, stored encrypted.
hints.ado: Read by the server every 15 minutes with a read-only PAT, stored encrypted.

scope.jira: Project keys (e.g. BOR, APO) — empty: all
